correctness.rationale: Exact identity alpha^T D alpha = beta^T C beta - 2 sum_j t_j z_j^2 for zero-sum alpha proves positive-semidefinite rank-one monotonicity for every pendant lengthening. Fourier decomposition of C yields a double least centered eigenvalue only at the frequency-two pair for odd n; the odd-cycle leaf evaluation determinant sin(4 pi d/n) is nonzero at two distinct sites. Two-by-two projected perturbation gives the exact first-order slope and placement. Even cycles have an unaffected core-only zero mode. Replayed 32 rational identities, 1350 two-site eigenvalue tests, 168 first-order diagnostic cases.

value.rationale: A natural Hilbert-embedding stability margin for the full cyclic sunlet has a sharp global support threshold: one strengthened pendant edge, no matter how much, cannot improve the least centered distance eigenvalue; two arbitrarily small lengthenings at distinct vertices always improve it on odd cycles, but even cycles have a permanent obstruction. The closed first-order two-site design with optimal separation and equal allocation is a motivated, scale-aware graph metric perturbation invariant, not merely numerical diagonalization. The distinction between uniform corona spectra and local reinforcement is mathematically structural.
